summary: Brand new account (8 followers, 6 posts). High skip rates (64-75%) show hooks fail in first 3s. '24hr delivery' reel got shares (51%) and comments (4.8%) but low watch time. 'Live preview' got views (783) but near-zero engagement. Zero IG DMs. Data thin: only 2 reels have retention metrics, no explore reach.
guidance:
- Hook style to try next: open with a real client screen-record ("Here's the site I built for a Manali homestay") — no talking head, no clock graphic.
- Avoid repeating "Rs 1,499 / 24 hrs" as the lead; it's used in 3 of 6 posts and correlates with steep drop-off.
- Every post must show actual code/design output (live preview, CMS edit, mobile scroll) — never a generic promise graphic.

instructions.research: Find 3 Himachal hotels/homestays with broken or missing websites; note their names and current Google Maps listings.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two reels' retention curves: identify the exact second where '24 clock' flatlines vs 'Live preview' drop — note visual difference at that frame.
instructions.writer: Draft a 90-char Hinglish hook for a reel showing a live site edit: "Manali café ka menu 30 sec me update — dekho live" (no price, no speed claim).
instructions.image: Create a carousel cover: split screen — left: client's old Google Maps 'no website' badge, right: your new site on phone. Caption: "Fixed in one afternoon."
instructions.video: Record a 15-sec screen capture: open the Netlify deploy log, tap the live URL, scroll homepage on mobile. No face, no text overlay, raw audio.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 recent posts by Himachal tourism pages or local hotel owners — ask a genuine question about their website needs.
Reply to the 16 comments on the '24 clock' reel with a specific follow-up: "Which section would you want to edit yourself?"
Add the WhatsApp link to your bio Linktree and post a Story: "Free 2-min site check — tap link, send URL."
